blocks.html: Private Fishing Charters in San José del Cabo

6-Hour & 8-Hour Private Fishing Trips from Puerto Los Cabos

Experience the best of Cabo fishing with Exotic Fish Cabo. We offer private sportfishing charters departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Baja California Sur, Mexico.

Our experienced local captains know the waters of the Sea of Cortez, including famous fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, and La Fortuna. Depending on the season, sea conditions, and your target species, our crew will help you explore some of the area's most productive inshore and offshore fishing spots.

Whether you're chasing marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, or roosterfish, we tailor every fishing trip to your experience level and goals.

From beginners and families to serious offshore anglers, everyone is welcome aboard. Fly fishing enthusiasts are welcome too — just bring your own fly-fishing equipment!

Our private fishing charters feature quality fishing tackle, experienced bilingual captains, and comfortable boats selected to match your group size and fishing preferences.

Choose Your Private Fishing Charter

We offer flexible 6-hour and 8-hour private fishing trips from San José del Cabo, giving you the freedom to choose the experience that suits you best.

3/4-Day Fishing Charter — 6 Hours

A great choice for anglers looking to enjoy both inshore and offshore fishing without committing to a full day on the water.

  • Duration: Approximately 6 hours

  • Fishing style: Inshore, midshore, or offshore, depending on conditions and your goals

  • Target species: Marlin, tuna, dorado, wahoo, roosterfish, and other local species

  • Best for: Couples, families, beginners, and experienced anglers seeking a flexible fishing adventure

  • Departure: 6:30 AM from Puerto Los Cabos Marina

  • Price: Starting at $350 USD per private boat (1–2 guests)

Full-Day Offshore Fishing Charter — 8 Hours

Designed for anglers who want more time on the water, with opportunities to explore offshore banks, deeper fishing grounds, and seasonal big-game fishing areas.

  • Duration: Approximately 8 hours

  • Fishing style: Offshore and big-game fishing, adapted to sea conditions and seasonal fish activity

  • Target species: Marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, and other pelagic species

  • Best for: Serious anglers, groups, and anyone seeking a full-day Cabo fishing adventure

  • Departure: 6:30 AM from Puerto Los Cabos Marina

  • Price: Starting at $600 USD per private boat

  • Group size: Boats available for 1–10 guests, depending on the vessel selected. Prices vary by boat and group size.

What's Included in Your Fishing Charter?

Every private charter includes:

  • Private fishing boat

  • Experienced bilingual captain and crew

  • Fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle

  • A fishing experience tailored to your group and target species

Fishing licenses, bait, food, and drinks can be discussed or arranged when booking. Our team will explain what is included with your selected boat and what you should bring.

Planning your fishing adventure? Explore our Family Fishing Charters in San José del Cabo for family-friendly options, or read our What to Bring on a Fishing Charter in Cabo. checklist to prepare for your day on the water.

Book Your San José del Cabo Fishing Adventure

Ready to experience the excitement of fishing in Los Cabos?

Contact Exotic Fish Cabo to choose your Fishing boat, check availability, and plan your private fishing charter.

Whether you're hoping to land your first dorado, battle a powerful yellowfin tuna, or chase the marlin of a lifetime, our local crew is ready to help you make the most of your day on the water.

blocks.html:
Our fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, providing access to some of the most productive fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez.

Our experienced local captains select fishing locations based on the season, weather, ocean conditions, and species you're hoping to catch.

Where do we fish?

  • Gordo Banks: One of the region's best-known offshore fishing grounds, with opportunities to target tuna, marlin, and other pelagic species.

  • Iman Bank: A popular fishing area for yellowfin tuna and other seasonal offshore species.

  • La Fortuna: Another fishing ground our captains may explore depending on fish activity and ocean conditions.

  • El 25, Vinorama, and San Luis: Additional fishing areas that offer different opportunities depending on the season and target species.

Our 6-hour charters focus on making the most of the available fishing time, while our 8-hour trips offer greater flexibility to explore offshore grounds when conditions allow.

Want to know what's biting right now?

Explore our Fishing Calendar and latest Fishing Reports for seasonal information and recent catches from San José del Cabo.
